guides.title: Best Dog Beds
guides.description: How to compare support, sizing, covers and cleanup.
checks: Measure sleeping length, not just body length
Match support to age and mobility
Prioritize removable washable covers
Confirm the return policy before sizing up

guides.title: Best Dog Harnesses
guides.description: Fit, control and comfort checks for daily walks.
checks: Measure neck and chest at the maker’s points
Check adjustment range and strap placement
Choose visibility for low-light walks
Recheck fit after the first few outings

guides.title: Best Dog Toys
guides.description: Choose play styles, materials and sizes more safely.
checks: Match the toy to the dog’s play style
Choose a size that cannot be swallowed
Inspect seams and surfaces regularly
Supervise new toys until wear is understood

guides.title: Best Cat Trees
guides.description: Stability, scratching surfaces and placement explained.
checks: Measure floor space and ceiling clearance
Prioritize a wide stable base
Check platform size for the cat
Place it where the household spends time

guides.title: Best Automatic Feeders
guides.description: Capacity, scheduling and cleaning checks before buying.
checks: Confirm food type and kibble-size compatibility
Check portion controls and schedule limits
Look for washable food-contact parts
Plan a backup for power or connectivity loss

guides.title: Best Aquarium Starter Kits
guides.description: A practical checklist for tanks, filtration and setup.
checks: Choose the species before choosing tank size
Confirm filtration and heater requirements
Allow time for a safe cycling process
Budget for testing and ongoing water care

guides.title: Best Pet Cameras
guides.description: Privacy, placement and useful features considered.
checks: Choose the viewing angle before the feature list
Review account and video privacy controls
Confirm alert and subscription requirements
Place cords and hardware out of reach

guides.title: Best Pet Travel Accessories
guides.description: Carriers, restraint, hydration and cleanup essentials.
checks: Check carrier dimensions and travel rules
Use vehicle restraints designed for the pet
Pack familiar food, water and identification
Test the setup before the full trip

guides.title: Best Pet Deals This Week
guides.description: How to spot useful value without false urgency.
checks: Start with products already on the shopping list
Verify the live merchant price
Compare size, quantity and delivered cost
Skip unfamiliar consumables without checking ingredients
